description: Calculates how often values occur within a range of values and then returns the first value of the returned vertical array of numbers.

params.description: An array of values or the selected range for which the frequencies will be counted (blanks and text are ignored).
params.name: arg1

params.description: An array of intervals or the selected range into which the values in the first range will be grouped.
params.name: arg2

signature: FREQUENCY(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number[], arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number[]): number
